{"id":"COR-2116","uuid":"860800fa-3239-4595-be2d-0c0acc52a8e4","title":"Retire ENTIRE_BRAIN_NO_EGRESS once disconnect is a recorded state","description":"Once `entire brain disconnect` records a durable per-repo opt-out (<issue id="995a1543-56ff-4846-a15f-98049539cabc" href="https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/COR-2109/brain-connectdisconnect-easy-user-facing-commands-for-hosted">COR-2109</issue>), the `ENTIRE_BRAIN_NO_EGRESS` / `ENTIRE_BRAIN_LOCAL_ONLY` env kill switch is probably redundant for normal use — users express "don't sync" through disconnect, and status would stop showing lines like `hosted: disconnected (ENTIRE_BRAIN_NO_EGRESS set)`.

**Decide, then do**

* Default position: remove the env var from the user-facing surface (docs, status rendering, help text).
* Before removing, check the cases where an env var is genuinely better than per-repo state and keep it for those if they hold up:
  * CI / test runs that must never egress regardless of what's on disk.
  * Machine-wide or org-pushed policy ("no egress on this laptop") that shouldn't depend on per-repo files existing.
* If kept for those, demote it to a documented testing/policy escape hatch, not a user-facing feature; status may still need to show it when set so suppressed syncs stay explainable.

Blocked by <issue id="995a1543-56ff-4846-a15f-98049539cabc" href="https://linear.app/entirehq/issue/COR-2109/brain-connectdisconnect-easy-user-facing-commands-for-hosted">COR-2109</issue> (disconnect must exist first). Decision (PR #388): the kill switch is **kept**, not retired. A source survey showed it gates every egress surface — distill agents, webhooks, `add` cloning, abstract providers, proposals, publish, hosted sync — so it is the machine/CI-wide policy control the ticket's "keep" cases describe; per-repo intent stays with `disconnect`.

Done per the "if kept" branch:

- `ENTIRE_BRAIN_NO_EGRESS` is the canonical name; `ENTIRE_BRAIN_LOCAL_ONLY` is a deprecated alias (still honored fail-closed, one-time warning, removed from help and error text).
- Demoted to a documented policy/testing escape hatch: SECURITY.md "Egress controls" is the single authoritative reference.
- Status and the webhook refusal still name the variable actually set, so suppressed syncs stay explainable.

content.text:
**COR-2111 + COR-2116 shipped as [PR #388](https://github.com/entireio/entire-brain/pull/388)**; both tickets are In Review with the PR attached and a decision comment on COR-2116.

- **`ENTIRE_BRAIN_ALLOW_HOSTED` deleted.** All three readers (`publish`, `facts sync --facts-backend=http`, `facts proposals`) require an explicit target with no defaults, so the env gate added no consent; a bare invocation still refuses egress-free.
- **Kill switch kept** — the ticket's default was "retire," but the source survey showed it gates every egress surface (agents, webhooks, `add` cloning, abstracts, proposals, hosted), which per-repo `disconnect` can't cover. `ENTIRE_BRAIN_NO_EGRESS` is canonical; `LOCAL_ONLY` is a still-honored deprecated alias that warns once. Status and the webhook refusal name the variable actually set.
- New SECURITY.md "Egress controls" section is the single precedence reference; living docs swept, historical docs (`pattern_v2`, press release, ga-readiness) left as point-in-time records.
- Validation: full `go test ./...` green, `gofmt -s` and `go vet` clean. The one test that pinned naming-the-actual-variable drove a small `noEgressToggleName` helper rather than a weakened assertion.

Two loose ends:

1. **Brain facts unwritten** — a leftover `/tmp/eb-validate/entire-brain workspace watch --distill` (pid 78971, ~25 min old) is holding the repo's brain write lock. It looks like a stray validation sandbox; I didn't kill it since it could be another session's. The decisions are recorded in the commit message, PR, and Linear regardless. Say the word and I'll kill it and retry the two `brain remember` calls.
2. **Branch name** — this workspace branch is still `cor-2135-notify-json-fix` from the cancelled ticket, so PR #388 rides a misleading branch name. I didn't rename per your standing instruction; tell me if you want it renamed.
